title: Fresh VPS from a stock cloud image (sudo user, root disabled): Docker app, hardening, backups, alerts
traps: the agent works through sudo as the image's default user: root login is disabled by cloud-init
a fail2ban or firewall change can ban the admin's own IP, and there is no root fallback
backups must actually run and be restorable, not just be configured
alerts must reach the user's ntfy topic
